reviews.title: Olio disrespect volunteers
reviews.text: I was collecting food and donating to homeless people and people that requested through the app. One day I’ve donated only to homeless people as I’ve found that this way no food waste is left. Then the next day, Olio ban me for 24 hours for not being doing listing. I was told from a colegue that even when they donate all food to homeless people, they just do some listings to satisfy the app, and even they don’t have this food anymore, but they do listings just not to get banned. I thought the idea is to help people, but seems is more a track and control the idea of the people creating the app. It was so good to help people in need, but seems that I will have to do this in different way, not through Olio as they think we the volunteers are some employees that taking good pay check, and that’s why Olio can demand so much unreasonable stuff. I’m sorry, but most likely I won’t do help through their app anymore. I will delete it now, and not participate in their disrespectful system 👎👎👎👎👎👎

reviews.title: Olio’s approach to Food Heroes: Discipline & Punishment
reviews.text:
I have been a Food Hero for years, always trying to share as widely as possible. 

Yet Olio recently suspended my account without warning, apparently because I shared food in a public place without a kitchen or fridge. The location was less than a two-minute walk from the store and close to my friend’s flat, where I could refrigerate the food if needed. Taking it home first would have meant at least an hour’s travel, making the public location arguably safer and more practical.

After years of hard work and goodwill, one alleged mistake led to suspension, with no warning or chance to explain.

Olio seems more interested in disciplining and punishing Food Heroes than supporting them.

reviews.title: Bad adverts
reviews.text: Just downloaded the app and it asked me to complete verification when I clicked on the link it wanted a 2p payment. I assumed this was part of the part but it was a third party advert trying to set up a subscription. Luckily my bank blocked but shame on Olio for allowing such scamming adverts on their app. As a new user it wasn’t clear this was an advert rather than part of the app.

reviews.title: Some good points, but untrustworthy review system
reviews.text:
I have had mixed success on here. People’s ratings are misleading. I bought a very low quality bed frame, but I was not able to leave a review for the seller because they removed their listing, even though I had already bought the item in question and had it delivered (expensively).
Some people use this platform to get rid of their unusable junk, and there should be a mechanism for separating these users from reliable people
